svg.font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif
svg.title: Large commerce platform (28 nodes)
svg.desc: 1. web → cdn: static files; 2. app → gw: request; 3. web → gw: request; 4. gw → auth: verify token; 5. auth → redis: session; 6. gw → user: profile; 7. user → mysql: SELECT; 8. gw → cart: add item; 9. cart → redis: save; 10. gw → order: place order; 11. order → stock: reserve; 12. stock → mysql: UPDATE; 13. order → coupon: apply; 14. order → point: deduct; 15. order → pay: authorize; 16. pay → pg: authorize; 17. pg → pay: approved; 18. pay → order: done; 19. order → kafka: order.created; 20. kafka → ship: consume 20. kafka → notify: consume 20. kafka → report: consume; 21. notify → mail: send 21. notify → sms: send; 22. ship → mysql: INSERT; 23. gw → search: search; 24. search → es: query; 25. gw → reco: recommend; 26. reco → es: similar items; 27. gw → review: write review; 28. review → s3: photos; 29. admin → gw: manage; 30. batch → report: aggregate; 31. report → s3: CSV
